Privacy Policy

Last updated: 17 October 2026

What we collect

Account details: name and email.

Meet-AI: for meetings you schedule, participant names, join and leave times, raised hands and captions.

E-Docs: files are processed in your browser. Output files are saved only if you sign in and choose to save.

Technical data: browser type and IP address, for security.

How we use it

To run the service, send reports and alerts, keep it secure and improve it. We do not sell your data.

Sharing

Only with essential service providers (such as hosting and email), or when required by law.

Your rights

You may ask to access, correct or delete your information, as provided under India’s Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023.

Security and retention

We use reasonable safeguards. Data is kept as long as needed for the service or by law.

Cookies

We use only essential cookies and sign-in tokens.

Privacy questions: adligaretech@gmail.com
